units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 92a:10">Snh. 92ᵃ</cite> <he>אדם שיש בו ד׳</he> a man that has obtained knowledge.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 1:6">Lev. R. s. 1</cite> (prov.) <he>ד׳ קנית וכ׳</he> if thou hast acquired knowledge, what doest thou lack? &c.—

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:3">Cant. R. to IV, 3</cite> <he>ד׳ סרוחה של וכ׳</he> the corrupt mind of, i.e. the fool, Ahasver; a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>דֵּעוֹת</he>, <he>דֵּיעוֹת</he> (used also in Chald. phrases).

<cite ref="Shevuot 42a:9">Shebu. 42ᵃ</cite> <he>אזלינן בתר רוב ד׳</he> we are guided by the majority of opinions; <cite ref="Yoma 83a:6">Yoma 83ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Temurah 27b:24">Tem. 27ᵇ</cite> <he>בתר ד׳ אזלינן</he>. Shebu. l. c. <he>כיון דנחית לד׳</he> since he cared to mention a certain number of minds (as witnesses).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 1:8:4">Y. Sot. I, 17ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 5:9">Tosef. ib. V, 9</cite>; a. e. <he>כשם שיש ד׳ וכ׳</he> as men differ in tastes (sensibilities) as regards food and drink, so do husbands differ &c.

<cite ref="Pesachim 112a:14">Pes. 112ᵃ</cite> <he>ארבע ד׳ וכ׳</he> there are four thoughts &c. (the husband thinking of his first wife and the wife of her first husband); a. fr. V. <cite ref="D00950"><he>דַּעַת</he></cite>.
